name: time-arithmetic
summary: Deterministic date/time/timezone math, exposed as an MCP server.
problem: Language models are well-documented to get DST transitions, month/year rollover, and cross-timezone elapsed-time math wrong when they compute it by reasoning instead of by calculation -- a 2025 University of Edinburgh study (DateTimeReasoning) found even top models fail basic clock/calendar questions, and developer write-ups describe silently-wrong UTC conversions and 'same time' scheduling bugs across timezones.
